title: Pipeline with Closures
goal: Arrange the iterator pipeline to filter short words and sum the remaining lengths.
hints: A slice `&[&str]` must be converted into an iterator using `.iter()` before iterator methods can be called.
Filtering must operate on string slices before `.map()` converts each string into a `usize`.
explanation: The pipeline must start with `.iter()` to produce an iterator of string slice references (`&&str`). Next, `.filter(|w| w.len() > 3)` keeps strings with more than 3 characters. After filtering, `.map(|w| w.len())` converts each string slice into a `usize`. Placing `.map` before `.filter` would turn elements into `usize`, causing `.filter` to fail with `E0599` because `usize` has no `.len()` method. Finally, `.sum()` consumes the iterator of integers.
